entries.title: Proverbs 8:1
segments: Doth not wisdom cry, And understanding put forth her voice?

entries.title: Proverbs 8:2
segments: On the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:3
segments: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:4
segments: Unto you, O men, I call; And my voice is to the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:5
segments: O ye simple, understand prudence; And, ye fools, be of an understanding heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:6
segments: Hear, for I will speak excellent things; And the opening of my lips shall be right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:7
segments: For my mouth shall utter truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:8
segments: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:9
segments: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:10
segments: Receive my instruction, and not silver; And knowledge rather than choice gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:11
segments: For wisdom is better than rubies; And all the things that may be desired are not to be compared unto it.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:12
segments: I wisdom have made prudence my dwelling, And find out knowledge [and] discretion.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:13
segments: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil: Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the perverse mouth, do I hate.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:14
segments: Counsel is mine, and sound knowledge: I am understanding; I have might.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:15
segments: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:16
segments: By me princes rule, And nobles, [even] all the judges of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:17
segments: I love them that love me; And those that seek me diligently shall find me.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:18
segments: Riches and honor are with me; [Yea], durable wealth and righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:19
segments: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my revenue than choice silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:20
segments: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:21
segments: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:22
segments: Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, Before his works of old.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:23
segments: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Before the earth was.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:24
segments: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:25
segments: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:26
segments: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:27
segments: When he established the heavens, I was there: When he set a circle upon the face of the deep,

entries.title: Proverbs 8:28
segments: When he made firm the skies above, When the fountains of the deep became strong,

entries.title: Proverbs 8:29
segments: When he gave to the sea its bound, That the waters should not transgress his commandment, When he marked out the foundations of the earth;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:30
segments: Then I was by him, [as] a master workman; And I was daily [his] delight, Rejoicing always before him,

entries.title: Proverbs 8:31
segments: Rejoicing in his habitable earth; And my delight was with the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:32
segments: Now therefore, [my] sons, hearken unto me; For blessed are they that keep my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:33
segments: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:34
segments: Blessed is the man that heareth me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:35
segments: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And shall obtain favor of Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:36
segments: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: All they that hate me love death.
